# Auto data set loaderd from ISLR 
```{r}
library(ISLR)
data("Auto")
print(summary(Auto))

#quantitative printed
```
```{r}
summary(Auto$horsepower)
summary(Auto$mpg)

```
#Categorical variable printed
```{r}
print(table(Auto$origin))
print(table(Auto$name))
```

#transformation
#MPG to KPL

```{r}
Auto$mpg_kpl<-Auto$mpg *0.425144
summary(Auto$mpg_kpl)
```
#graph

```{r}
plot(Auto$mpg,Auto$horsepower,
main = "MPG VS Horsepower",
xlab ="horsepower",
ylab ="Miles Per gallon")
```
```{r}
hist(Auto$mpg,
     main = "Cars MPG",
     xlab = "Distrubution",
     ylab = "MPG")
```
